text: {"lessons":["My patience through ordinary month-to-month fluctuations has suited my long-term approach; I should avoid trading just to react to short-term moves.","Selling portions of Stock B and Stock D realized gains and reduced exposure, but gains versus average cost alone do not justify a sale; I should also assess prospects and portfolio risk.","Because losses weigh on me more than gains please me, I should guard against holding losers too long or taking profits too early, and follow a consistent plan rather than emotion."]}
